name: Best Guacamole

ingredients.name: Finely chopped white onion (about ½ small onion)
Small jalapeño, seeds and ribs removed, finely chopped
Lime juice (from about 1½ limes), or more if needed

steps: Using a spoon, scoop the flesh of the avocados into a low serving bowl, discarding any bruised, browned areas.
Using a pastry cutter, potato masher, or fork, mash up the avocado until it reaches your desired texture (some texture is nice — stop mashing once there are just small chunks remaining).
Promptly add the onion, cilantro, jalapeño, lime juice, coriander, and salt. Stir to combine.
Taste and add more salt if needed, until the flavors really sing. If it needs more zip, add a little more lime juice.
notes: A snack/side, not a full meal — pair it with a higher-protein main rather than counting it as lunch or dinner on its own.

flags.shelfLife: Best eaten the same day — avocado browns quickly even with the lime juice.
